corrected_fields.summary: Bank of Canada publishes daily money market yield data including the Overnight Money Market Financing Rate, Canadian Overnight Repo Rate Average (CORRA), and Treasury bill yields for maturities ranging from 1 month to 1 year. Data shows rates around 2.25-2.68% across various tenors as of March 30, 2026. Note: This is raw data only, with no analysis or commentary.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: These yield levels represent the current cost of short-term borrowing in Canadian dollars and are inputs for rate expectations and monetary policy assessment. The CORRA serves as a benchmark for overnight repo transactions in Canada's金融市场. However, this record contains only numerical data without analysis.
corrected_fields.macro_context: Canadian money market rates around 2.25-2.68% reflect current monetary conditions in Canada. The data shows a typical upward-sloping yield curve in the short end, with 1-year bills yielding roughly 40 basis points more than 1-month bills. This record provides no interpretation or policy context.
corrected_fields.market_structure_context: CORRA (Canadian Overnight Repo Rate Average) is the key overnight market rate in Canada, functioning analogously to SOFR in the US market. The Overnight Money Market Financing Rate is the Bank of Canada's operating target for monetary policy.
